LightningComponentBundle.description: Marketing and Data - Configurable marketing engagement timeline (Email, SMS, Form, Page View) with live search and typed colored icons. Mock data mode - no Apex, no SOQL. Bilingual EN / FR.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'. Controls card title, search placeholder and empty state text.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty for the language dictionary default.

property.name: eventTypes
property.label: Event types (pipe-separated)
property.default: Email Open|Email Sent|Email Open|Email Open|Email Sent|SMS Sent|Email Open|Email Click
property.description: Recognized types: Email Open, Email Sent, Email Click, Email Bounce, SMS Sent, SMS Click, Form Submit, Page View.

property.name: eventLists
property.label: Lists / campaigns (pipe-separated)
property.default: Hot Lead - Q2 Campaign|Hot Lead - Q2 Campaign|Nurturing - Web Form|Nurturing - Web Form|Nurturing - Web Form|SMS Automation - Follow-up|Summer Campaign 2026|Summer Campaign 2026

property.name: eventAges
property.label: Relative ages (pipe-separated)
property.default: 5 d. 19 h. ago|5 d. 21 h. ago|6 d. 20 h. ago|1 mo. 2 d. ago|1 mo. 2 d. ago|1 mo. 3 d. ago|1 mo. 5 d. ago|1 mo. 5 d. ago
